title: In the Castle
subtitle: Harder than the sands, warmer than the stones. Another shelter that you can count on.

items.text: In the Castle
Guest Room, St. Foundation

items.speaker: Guard I
items.text: Where on earth do these seeds come from?

items.speaker: Guard I
items.text: They are stuck in the crevices. Can't even get them out with the gravity vacuum cleaner. It's like they are rooted, tsk.

items.speaker: Guard II
items.text: They weren't here until a few days ago. I heard some of these seeds were also found in the rehab center, but the staff there got rid of them in no time.

items.speaker: Guard I
items.text: Bloody hell, looks like we have to dig them out one by one with our fingers. Gotta get it done before the inspector's here.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Seed ... What seed?

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hmm, let me take a look ...
She stands on tiptoe, trying her best to figure out what's happening outside the room through the ground glass.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: *sighs* I can't see anything! I'm so bored.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Do I really have to sign the agreement to get out? But I haven't discussed it with anyone yet.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: "A fair lady always thinks it through and reaches an agreement with the adults before she signs any document ..."

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Mr. Karson has said that hundreds of times. It must be vital!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: ... Mmm.
There comes a disturbance from the other side of the door.

items.speaker: Material Room Staff
items.text: Backup, we need backup! Emergency!

items.speaker: Material Room Staff
items.text: A whole forest appears in room 101, the material area! It's ... It's growing out of Timekeeper's suitcase!

items.speaker: Guard II
items.text: What are you talking about?

items.speaker: Material Room Staff
items.text: As I said, it's an emergency. The staff in room 102 and 103 are here to help.

items.speaker: Material Room Staff
items.text: A large number of branches came out of the suitcase. They can detect our positions and even attack us on their own!

items.speaker: Guard I
items.text: Did you use Drako Drought?

items.speaker: Material Room Staff
items.text: Of course not! The room is full of inflammables. The whole floor would be burning now if we did.

items.speaker: Material Room Staff
items.text: We used military chainsaws, but it's a drop in the bucket ...

items.speaker: Guard I
items.text: Fine. I'll go apply for a few more. Just wait for me there.

items.speaker: Guard I
items.text: Agata, go help them out!

items.speaker: Guard II
items.text: Roger that!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: A forest is growing out of Ms. Vertin's suitcase ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Could it be ... Ms. Druvis's great arcane skill?☆

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The guards are gone ... Ugh, I wish I could see that bizarre scene myself.
Click ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hmm? What's that strange sound?
She lays her eyes on the shut door.
The keyhole is rattling.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hmm ... Is the door shaking?
The rattle visibly becomes stronger.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: No, something ... something is coming in!
The lock shakes so violently, as if it were wrestling something invisible.
The newborn vine ruthlessly pierces through the lock, leaving the latter hanging in the air like lifeless grapes.
The air smells like fresh plant juice.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Wow ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: The lock, it's actually broken ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Which means I'm free to go? Hooray!!
The door quietly opens, giving a way to the outside world.
The place outside has turned into a vigorous new world.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Wow ...! The seeds on the ground have all sprouted ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: What on earth is going on?
She is baffled, as she fiddles with the sprouts on the ground.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hmm, the seeds have the same color as the crevice's. I would have missed them if I didn't look carefully ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Such a slender branch actually broke the lock. How marvelous! You are Ms. Sotheby's hero!

items.speaker: Foundation Staff
items.text: Hey! How did you get out?!
She is violently pushed to the ground.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Ugh ... That hurts!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: How rude you are! My potions are broken!

items.speaker: Foundation Staff
items.text: Did you conjure these plants? Stop them now!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Huh? What are you talking about?
She turns around to surprisedly find that the sprouts, soaked in the potion, are visibly getting thicker and stronger.

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Oh my ...

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: It's my ... Quick Quick Growth Potion for plants!
Twigs thicken into branches, and more new branches come out from them. And new leaves, new sprouts. They crawl forward, forming a tree fortress around Sotheby.

items.speaker: Foundation Staff
items.text: What do you think you're doing?! Stop them!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Hmph, no way!

items.speaker: Sotheby
items.text: Come on! Try and catch me again if you can!
TO BE CONTINUED…
